verdict.rationale: First-party material says llamafile supports GGUF models, including Llama, Mistral, Gemma and Phi. It runs on the llama.cpp stack and bundles model weights with the executable, and community users report running llamafiles locally successfully. Missing for 10: documentation of loading a standalone or external GGUF file (e.g. a model-path flag), detail on which GGUF quantization variants are supported, and independent hands-on confirmation of loading GGUF files specifically.
